name: Minimal Nordic
description: Negative space, a spare iron ring, and only the marks needed to navigate.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. Cardinal letters are baked into the fixed ring. The ivory heading lozenge has a dark tail and ochre north tip, with 11.02x the opaque mass of the hairline teal wind arrow.

orientationConventions.ring: Static north-up broken-circle card. N is baked at 12 o'clock.
orientationConventions.headingPointer: The bright half and ochre tip point to 12 o'clock at heading 0; the dark half is the tail. Its boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure player world bearing.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The hairline teal arrow points to 12 o'clock at wind bearing 0. Its pivot is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure wind-toward world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Optional static top accent for the north index. It does not replace the heading pointer.
